description: Create an email marketing campaign. Content: either a saved templateId, or inline subject+body. Audience: a CRM segment via contactFilters ({ filters:[…], logic:'AND' }) OR an explicit excelRecipients list ([{ email, name, variables }]). Pass run=true to create AND send immediately in one call. Sends on the same durable, resumable engine as the app (safe for large lists, no duplicates).

body.description: Inline HTML body (when not using a template).

contentSource.description: Content source; inferred from templateId/subject when omitted.

provider.description: Mailbox to send from: 'google'/'microsoft' or a connection id.

recipientSource.description: Audience source; inferred from contactFilters/excelRecipients when omitted.

run.description: Create AND send now in one call (default false).

runAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 time to schedule the send.

subject.description: Inline subject (when not using a template).

templateId.description: Saved email template id (omit if using inline subject+body).

name: gambot_create_email_campaign
title: Create email campaign
